summary: Deepgram Pay As You Go grants $200 in signup credits with no credit card and no expiration. The earlier free Flux TTS promo through September 14, 2026 has ended. A separate paid Flux TTS credit-match promotion runs September 15 through December 31, 2026 (11:59 p.m. Pacific Time): each eligible active Pay-As-You-Go or Growth project in good standing, with accurate billing information and a valid payment method, can receive $1 bonus credit per $1 of qualifying paid-credit Flux TTS usage, up to $500 per project. Usage funded by the $200 signup grant or any other promotional/bonus credits does not qualify. Bonus credits are project-specific and non-expiring; Enterprise projects are excluded. Auto-reload is optional and can charge the stored payment method if enabled. The paid-match deadline is not an expiry for the ongoing $200 signup credit.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up Free at https://deepgram.com/pricing; the $200 signup credit requires no credit card and does not expire.
Create a console account and API key; monitor the project balance while using supported STT, TTS and Voice Agent APIs.

Optional paid Flux TTS match: read the separate promo terms. Only active PAYG/Growth projects in good standing with accurate billing information and a valid payment method qualify; Enterprise projects are excluded.
Only Flux TTS usage funded by purchased credits earns the $1-per-$1 match, up to $500 per eligible project. Spending signup or bonus/promotional credits does not earn matching.

The paid-match promotion ends December 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time. Bonus credits are project-specific; auto-reload is optional but can charge your payment method if enabled. This deadline does not apply to the $200 signup grant.
